posts.title: How to Actually Get Tickets to Visit the Colosseum’s Attic or Basement
posts.description: <et cetera> The biggest takeaway is that you need to have a really fast internet connection, preferably ethernet. Wifi / Mobile Data may not work. These tips are for the “good” / special tickets (underground, attic), and not the general arena tickets. AFAICT, you can buy the general arena tickets multiple days in advance, unlike the special ones which get sold out 1 month in advance. Scroll to tip
